name: Front
one_liner: Shared team inbox and customer communication platform with a Core API and MCP server.
auth_notes: Bearer tokens come from company-level API tokens or OAuth 2.0. Front recommends OAuth where feasible. Public integrations must use OAuth unless Front grants an exception.
access_notes: Admins create API tokens under Settings > Developers. Public integrations must use OAuth unless Front grants an exception. Cost and plan gating are not stated on the fetched pages.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve admin API tokens work for a single Front instance. Public integrations for all customers must use OAuth and may need a Front exception. Plan gating is not on the fetched pages.

identity.quote: Here is Front's Core API, a backend API that gives comprehensive control over all entities in Front from Contacts to Comments.

auth.quote: Front supports OAuth2.0 as well as API Tokens.
The Core API uses Bearer tokens to authenticate its user.

access.quote: OAuth is required for public integrations available to all Front customers unless you obtain an exception from us.
